tenders.title: Provision of Building Information Modelling (BIM) Scanning, Modelling, and Facilities Management (FM) Data Integration
tenders.scope_summary: The tender seeks services for Building Information Modelling (BIM) scanning, modelling, and integration of Facilities Management (FM) data. This involves creating a 3D model, incorporating relevant information for facility operations, and ensuring data compatibility for efficient asset management.
key_points: Focus on comprehensive data for asset lifecycle

tenders.title: Asset Performance Management Systems Installation Tender Notice
tenders.scope_summary: Procurement and installation of 1208 Asset Performance Management Systems on high AT&C loss feeders as per specification PPMC-DS-01:2026. Bidders must register on EPADS Version 2.0 and submit electronic bids.
key_points: Supply, installation, and commissioning of APMS units

tenders.title: Procurement and Installation of 1235 Nos Asset Performance Management System on High AT&C Loss Feeders
tenders.scope_summary: The tender is for the procurement and installation of 1235 units of Asset Performance Management System (APMS) on high AT&C loss feeders. This includes supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and integration of APMS equipment on pole-mounted distribution transformers.
key_points: Procurement and installation of 1235 APMS units
Transformer level monitoring, protection, load management, energy auditing, remote operation
Electronic submission via National Single Stage-One Envelope method
